content.text:
Yes. I queried the AlphaFold Database API (`mcp__biomni__query_alphafold`, endpoint `prediction`) for UniProt **P37840** (SYUA_HUMAN, gene *SNCA*, *Homo sapiens*, taxId 9606) — the canonical human alpha-synuclein, 140 aa. The API returned three models: the canonical isoform plus two splice isoforms.

**Canonical: AF-P37840-F1** (model v6, created 2025-08-01, AlphaFold Monomer v2.0 pipeline)
- Residues 1–140 (full length), chain A
- Mean pLDDT: **75.19**
- PDB: https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P37840-F1-model_v6.pdb
- mmCIF: https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P37840-F1-model_v6.cif
- PAE JSON: `AF-P37840-F1-predicted_aligned_error_v6.json`; per-residue pLDDT: `AF-P37840-F1-confidence_v6.json`

**Isoforms also modelled**
- `AF-P37840-2-F1` — P37840-2, 112 aa (alpha-synuclein-112), mean pLDDT 82.00
- `AF-P37840-3-F1` — P37840-3, 126 aa (alpha-synuclein-126), mean pLDDT 83.31

**Confidence breakdown for the canonical model** (fractions reported by the API): very low (pLDDT <50) 12.9%, low (50–70) 24.3%, confident (70–90) 33.6%, very high (>90) 29.3%.

An important interpretive caveat: alpha-synuclein is an intrinsically disordered protein in its free monomeric state. A mean pLDDT of 75 with ~29% of residues above 90 does not mean a well-defined native fold exists — AlphaFold characteristically returns an extended amphipathic helix for the N-terminal/NAC region, which reflects the membrane-bound helical propensity rather than a single solution conformation. The acidic C-terminal tail is the low-pLDDT portion. Treat this model as a conformational hypothesis, not a native structure. If you want the per-residue profile to see exactly where confidence falls off, I can pull the confidence JSON, or run `predict_protein_disorder_regions` on the sequence for an independent disorder call. Experimental fibril structures also exist in the PDB; I did not query that database here, so I'm not quoting IDs.

## ANSWER

Yes — AlphaFold DB entry **AF-P37840-F1** (UniProt **P37840**, SNCA, human), model v6, residues 1–140, mean **pLDDT 75.19**.
Download: https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P37840-F1-model_v6.pdb
Isoform models: AF-P37840-2-F1 (112 aa, pLDDT 82.0), AF-P37840-3-F1 (126 aa, pLDDT 83.3).
Caveat: alpha-synuclein is intrinsically disordered; the model is not a native single conformation.
